verdict.rationale: Better Auth documents an Auth0 migration guide and script. It covers email/password users "with proper hashing", social accounts, 2FA and best-effort organization migration. A configurable password hashing function lets imported hashes keep verifying. The no-lock-in half rests on community reports that all auth data lives in your own database and that the adapter design makes switching relatively easy. missing for 10: a general-purpose bulk-import tool or API beyond the Auth0-specific guide, a documented export feature or format, explicit documentation of importing arbitrary third-party hash formats, and independent hands-on confirmation of a round-trip migration.
